blockers.prerequisite: The installed native host must complete the named API or emit the expected native lifecycle event using the isolated offline transport; no synthetic event fallback is permitted.
The installed native host must complete the named API or emit the expected native lifecycle event using the isolated offline transport; no synthetic event fallback is permitted.

compaction_apis.claude: CLI --print --resume with /compact; no compact subcommand is exposed by installed --help. Pass requires actual SessionStart source=compact plus subsequent provider ingress.
compaction_apis.codex: Installed app-server thread/compact/start returns {}; completion requires item/completed contextCompaction plus matching threadId/turnId turn/completed status=completed before continuation, and actual SessionStart source=compact.
compaction_apis.omp: RPC compact calls AgentSession.compact; session-maintenance emits session_compact only after committing a compaction entry. Default keepRecentTokens=20000; genuine numeric-padding turns make history compactable without lowering this setting.
